generic_sampling_rules.integer_primary_key: Sequential 1..N per table; no NULL; no duplicates.
generic_sampling_rules.integer_foreign_key: Sample from the parent's id pool (1..N_parent); 0% NULL; guarantee at least one parent row with no children and at least one child row per parent; never emit 0 or values outside the parent pool.
generic_sampling_rules.text_enum: Sample uniformly from the enumerated value pool for that column; no other values; near-variants and upper-case literals are query literals only and are never generated.
generic_sampling_rules.text_short: Sample values from the column's pool; no near-variants unless the column is listed in per_column_exceptions.
generic_sampling_rules.integer_small: Sample from the column's enumerated pool; no other values.
generic_sampling_rules.fresh_values: 0% fresh values; every column draws from its enumerated pool.
generic_sampling_rules.null_rule: Each nullable column gets at least one NULL row per instance; NULL share follows the compact database's share (0.0 observed, so plant exactly one NULL per nullable column per instance); NOT NULL and primary-key columns never get NULL; planted NULLs are never replaced to satisfy a rule; rules constrain only non-NULL operands; do not plant a NULL in a column with fewer than 2 generated rows and assert each nullable column keeps at least one non-NULL value.
generic_sampling_rules.boundary_values: For each numeric column listed in per_column_exceptions, include the listed literals and one step on each side within the column's domain; literals outside the column's semantic range (e.g. 0 for a positive id, 5 for position) are query literals only and are never generated.
generic_sampling_rules.tie_rule: For ORDER columns listed in per_column_exceptions, assign values so the listed rank ties (equal counts) across the generated rows; the tie is enforced after sampling and before NULL planting, and the planted NULL is placed so the tie on non-NULL counts is preserved.
generic_sampling_rules.duplicate_rule: For DISTINCT columns listed in per_column_exceptions, ensure a 20-50% duplicate share among generated non-NULL values.
generic_sampling_rules.group_size_rule: For GROUP columns listed in per_column_exceptions, assign foreign-key values so the listed group sizes occur exactly; the assignment must cover every generated child row (sum of sizes equals the child row count) and must not drop a required size; if the required sizes cannot fit the child row count, raise a clear error rather than truncating.
